_note: Not a schema-bound contract (no schemas/brand.schema.json - kept lightweight on purpose). A reference file so narration-voice and palette choices don't get re-decided from scratch on every new project, the way SC-generate_avrasya_narration.py's voice pick (Rachel -> 402 error -> Daniel) had to be worked out live this session. Scripts MAY read this; nothing currently enforces it - a project's own template_ref/style_profile_ref stays authoritative when they conflict with a preset below.

restrained_documentary.note: Evidence-presenting register, low affect. First choice attempted was ElevenLabs' library voice 'Rachel' (21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM) - 402'd, free tier can't use library voices via API. Daniel is in this account's own premade voice list. TPL-ryskulov-hybrid also cites this style profile's restrained tone as a baseline, but PRJ-ryskulov-mektubu itself was produced with dark_dramatic (below) per an explicit user request for a darker register - see that preset's note.

dark_dramatic.note: User asked explicitly for a darker, more dramatic tone than restrained_documentary/warm_storyteller for a grave historical subject (the Kazak famine letter to Stalin). Adam's low, firm register fits without tipping into overacting (rejected 'Harry - Fierce Warrior' for that reason). Delivery tuned more expressive than restrained_documentary's defaults (stability 0.7/style 0.05): lower stability (0.45) for natural weight/variation, higher style (0.35) for emotional engagement. This is a TTS delivery-parameter choice only, never a rewrite of source_text - narration wording stays exactly as sourced from the cited research report.

warm_storyteller.note: Narrative-history register with a human-story throughline (Salavat Yulayev etc.) - warmer than restrained_documentary.

bright_playful.note: Children's fairytale register. This is the .env ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID default - correct for that project, wrong for anything documentary/historical (confirmed the hard way when it was still the default going into Avrasya's narration work).

historical_epic_steppe.note: See style/historical_epic_steppe.json directly for the full palette - not duplicated here, this file only exists to help PICK a register, not to override the style profile that's already the single source of truth once a project commits to one.

signature_outro.note: CLAUDE.md §11 - always the last production step, after any content fixes. Carries a small baked-in 'KlingAI 3.0' watermark from its own generation tool, flagged to the human, not something this file changes.
